Computing the first derivative, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={(2{x}^{3}+\frac{1}{x})}^{′} \\  & ={(2{x}^{3}+{x}^{-1})}^{′} \\  & =2(3){x}^{2}-{x}^{-2} \\  & =6{x}^{2}-{x}^{-2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the second derivative, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{″}(x) & =(6{x}^{2}-{x}^{-2})^{′} \\  & =6(2)x-(-2){x}^{-3} \\  & =12x+2{x}^{-3}.\end{aligned}
$$
